title: Schizophrenia Explained: Psychological Causes & CBT
welcome_lead: Family dysfunction, cognition and the talking cure.

concepts.def: Bateson — contradictory parental messages create confusion.

walkthroughs.body_html: Bateson (1956): contradictory parental messages — double bind — confuse the child's reality testing. Brown & Birley (1972): 58% relapse in high-EE families vs 16% in low-EE within 9 months of discharge. Both are now seen as triggers rather than causes.

Frith (1992): schizophrenia involves failure of metarepresentation — the ability to monitor one's own intentions, leading to hallucinations being misattributed. Central control failure explains disorganised speech.

CBTp combines reality-testing of delusions, normalising hallucinations, and coping strategies. NICE recommends 16+ sessions. Jauhar et al. (2014) meta-analysis: small effect (d = 0.40) on positive symptoms. Family therapy added cuts relapse by half (Pharoah 2010).
